questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw oranges are harvested across all commercial orchards in the state of Florida in a single year?
reasoning: Florida produces roughly 50 million boxes of oranges annually.
Each box of oranges weighs approximately 40 kilograms.
50 million boxes multiplied by 40 kilograms per box equals 2 billion kilograms.

questions.prompt: How many total individual plastic grocery bags are distributed by all supermarket checkout counters across Australia in a single year?
reasoning: Australia has a population of approximately 26 million people who visit supermarkets multiple times a week.
An average shopper uses about 3 lightweight or reusable-equivalent plastic bags per supermarket trip.
Multiplying weekly visits across the population yields roughly 4 billion bags distributed annually.

questions.prompt: How many total hours do all domestic pet hamsters kept in households across Germany run on exercise wheels collectively in a single year?
reasoning: There are approximately 1 million pet hamsters kept in households throughout Germany.
Each hamster runs on its exercise wheel for an average of 0.5 hours per day.
1 million hamsters multiplied by 0.5 hours per day gives 500,000 hours per day.
500,000 hours per day multiplied by 365 days in a year yields 182.5 million hours.
